acceptanceCriteria.summary: Handoff docs no longer name completed scope-honesty work as the next product blocker.
Fresh matching Goal Loop scheduler guidance remains subordinate to confirmationQueue.primary.
Stale or mismatched Goal Loop guidance is hidden or downgraded.
Ordinary sequential paths do not show scheduler, parallel, or full-auto wording.
Worker failure points to bounded rework; IntegrationFix wording is reserved for aggregate failures.
Scoped automation does not widen to raw scheduler or terminal gates.
No-code close is allowed when audit finds no product gap.
